title: LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.17108v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a 4 GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an 8 GB Jetson Orin Nano Super. Deployed formats (GPTQ, AWQ, llama.cpp's K- and I-quants) spend equal bits on every integer code of a matrix, although the codes are far from uniform. LazyWeights keeps these formats but tunes GPTQ so the codes compress, Huffman-codes them losslessly in interleaved lanes, and decodes them on demand in a small unit between DRAM and L2, so GPU kernels run unchanged and DRAM moves only coded bytes. At 1% and 3.5% perplexity budgets, coded Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and SmolLM-1.7B are 5.7-31.4% smaller than the best llama.cpp format. A bit-exact 0.21 mm^2 ASIC decoder unit (1 GHz, 7 nm) cuts Orin latency and energy per token by up to 36% and 38% (54% and 44% with prompt-lookup speculation). translated_title: LazyWeights：按需解码的边缘大语言模型
translated_abstract: 内存决定了边缘设备能运行哪些大语言模型以及运行得多快：在4 GB的Jetson Nano上受容量限制，在8 GB的Jetson Orin Nano Super上则受带宽限制。现有部署格式（GPTQ、AWQ、llama.cpp的K量化和I量化）对矩阵的每个整数编码分配相同的位数，尽管这些编码的分布远非均匀。LazyWeights保留了这些格式，但通过调整GPTQ使编码更易压缩，在交错通道中对编码进行无损Huffman编码，并在DRAM与L2缓存之间的一个小型单元中按需解码，因此GPU内核无需任何改动，DRAM只需传输编码后的字节。在1%和3.5%的困惑度预算下，编码后的Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B和SmolLM-1.7B比最佳的llama.cpp格式小5.7%-31.4%。一个位精确的0.21 mm² ASIC解码单元（1 GHz，7 nm工艺）将Orin上每个token的延迟和能耗最多降低36%和38%（结合prompt-lookup投机解码时可降低54%和44%）。在Nano上，LazyWeights每token所需时间比CPU版llama.cpp减少58%-64%，能耗减少53%-57%，并能运行……
tldr: LazyWeights在保留现有量化格式的基础上，通过对权重进行无损Huffman编码并在DRAM与L2之间用小型ASIC单元按需解码，在不改动GPU内核的前提下使边缘设备上的模型体积缩小5.7%-31.4%，并将每token的延迟和能耗最多降低约一半。
en_tdlr: LazyWeights compresses quantized LLM weights with lossless Huffman coding and decodes them on demand via a small ASIC unit between DRAM and L2, shrinking models by 5.7-31.4% and cutting per-token latency and energy by up to ~50% on edge devices without modifying GPU kernels.
